paper.title_en: Wald-like entropy and Islands in Dimensionally Reduced Einstein-Hilbert Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We study the island formula and Page curve for the asymptotically flat eternal and quasi-stationary evaporating black hole solutions within the dimensionally reduced Einstein-Hilbert (DREH) model. In this model, the four-dimensional Einstein-Hilbert action reduces to a two-dimensional dilaton gravity, on top of which the quantum corrections can be incorporated via the Polyakov-Liouville (PL) action for a two-dimensional conformal field theory with a large central charge $c$. This gravity model arises from the s-wave approximation of four-dimensional Einstein-Hilbert gravity and provides a fully gravitational setting in which we study the islands, i.e., we will not require a non-gravitational bath region to collect the radiation, instead it lives in the black hole spacetime itself. The fine-grained entropy of Hawking radiation in the eternal and evaporating black holes within the DREH model was derived using the island rule in \cite{djordjevic2022eternal, djordevic2025evaporating}. The island rule is based on the replica method using the Euclidean gravitational path integral. In this work, we complement the Euclidean approach by providing a Lorentzian prescription for the generalized entropy $S_{\text{gen}}$, in the island formula without invoking the replica trick to compute $S_{\text{gen}}$. The generalized entropy is shown to coincide with Wald-like Noether charge of the combined DREH-PL action. Using this generalized entropy, we determine the quantum extremal surface, the Page time, and the Page curve for the eternal and the evaporating black hole. We conclude with a discussion of the possible extension to the full four-dimensional geometry incorporating vacuum polarization corrections.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出Wald-like熵与DREH模型中的岛公式，提供了解析的洛伦兹方法，对黑洞热力学岛公式研究有重要贡献。
decision.title_zh: 降维爱因斯坦-希尔伯特引力中的Wald-like熵与岛
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在降维爱因斯坦-希尔伯特（DREH）模型中研究了渐近平坦永恒和准静态蒸发黑洞解的岛公式和Page曲线。在该模型中，四维爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量约化为二维膨胀引力，在此基础上可以通过具有大中心荷$c$的二维共形场论的Polyakov-Liouville（PL）作用量纳入量子修正。该引力模型产生于四维爱因斯坦-希尔伯特引力的s波近似，并提供了一个完全引力的背景，在其中我们研究岛，即我们不需要一个非引力的浴区域来收集辐射，而是辐射存在于黑洞时空本身。在DREH模型中，永恒和蒸发黑洞的霍金辐射的细粒熵是通过岛规则在\cite{djordjevic2022eternal, djordevic2025evaporating}中导出的。岛规则基于使用欧几里得引力路径积分的复制方法。在这项工作中，我们通过为广义熵$S_{\text{gen}}$提供洛伦兹规定来补充欧几里得方法，在岛公式中不调用复制技巧来计算$S_{\text{gen}}$。广义熵被证明与组合DREH-PL作用的Wald-like Noether荷重合。使用这个广义熵，我们确定了量子极值面、Page时间和永恒及蒸发黑洞的Page曲线。我们最后讨论了扩展到完整四维几何并纳入真空极化修正的可能性。
